summary: 护肤品多平台月度订单对账 — 数据清洗与交叉核对. 8 capability checks across 4 output files (folded from 20 atoms; pure aggregation).
check_strategy: private/expected_answer.json drives 20 internal atomic predicates; verify_task.py reads OUTPUT_DIR/ files, validates each atom, then emits 8 capability-unit checks (each = AND of its atoms; per-atom detail in reason).

checks.description: All three presence-only deliverables exist and parse: unified_orders.csv, exceptions.json (valid JSON), monthly_summary.json (valid JSON).
Heterogeneous-export standardization: correct column order, all order_date in yyyy-mm-dd, all status normalized to English labels, and JD/PDD sample rows have correct cross-platform field mapping.
Both seeded data-quality traps handled: PDD duplicates (PDD20260601003, PDD20260601010) appear exactly once, legacy code remapped (TM-20260601-016 -> LC-HEM-01), yielding exactly 75 data rows.
Fulfillment cross-check vs shipment_log: exactly 6 exceptions with correct type mix (3 unshipped, 2 partial, 1 over_shipped).
Settlement reconciliation with effective commission: JD discrepancy identified with signed difference +234.60.
Data-quality report includes both the PDD duplicate detection and the legacy-SKU remap entries.
Per-SKU x platform profit analysis: full 5x3=15-row matrix present, PDD effective 2% commission applied (not nominal 3%), and net-profit values match expected within tolerance.
Month-level aggregation: total revenue/cogs/commission/net_profit match expected, and best_sku=LC-REC-03 / worst_sku=LC-GCW-05 ranking correct.

notes: 8 capability checks folded from 20 atoms (pure AND aggregation; binary pass unchanged, verified refold+rerun 0 mismatch over 9 archived models). No mock API — pure file-based verification. Key traps: PDD deduplication, legacy SKU remap, PDD 2% effective commission (not 3%), JD settlement signed discrepancy.
